title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Lakeland corridors in Florida Southern College’s practical off-campus orbit, each paired with one documented reason to stop.

cards.entity_name: Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art
cards.title: See the Current Galleries
cards.subtitle: East Palmetto Street — free art museum
cards.notes: Walk north to East Palmetto Street and check the museum’s current-exhibition page before entering; general admission is always free.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian-affiliated art museum two blocks north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is at 800 East Palmetto Street, two blocks north of Florida Southern College, and admission is always free.
cards.source_title: The Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Located at 800 East Palmetto Street. Consult the museum’s visit information for current gallery hours.

cards.title: Settle In by Lake Morton
cards.subtitle: Lake Morton Drive — public library stop
cards.notes: Follow Lake Morton Drive to the main library and bring what you need for a reading or research session during posted public hours.
cards.short_summary: The city’s main library occupies a named lakeside address near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lakeland Public Library is located at 100 Lake Morton Drive and publishes regular public operating hours.
cards.access_notes: 100 Lake Morton Drive; Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–7 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m., Sunday 1:30–5 p.m.

cards.title: Catch a Film or Stage Event
cards.subtitle: South Florida Avenue — historic theater
cards.notes: Head up South Florida Avenue and consult the theater’s current calendar before going; individual events may carry age limits or ticket requirements.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown theater with a current program of films and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Polk Theatre operates at 121 South Florida Avenue and publishes current film and performance listings on its official site.
cards.source_title: Polk Theatre - Where Historic Is Cutting Edge
cards.access_notes: 121 South Florida Avenue. Check the individual listing for schedule, admission and any event-specific age restriction.

cards.title: Walk the Display Garden
cards.subtitle: East Orange Street — botanical garden
cards.notes: Continue to East Orange Street, stay on the established paths and leave bicycles outside; the garden is closed every Monday.
cards.short_summary: A formal 1.2-acre garden of patterned beds, public art and fountains.
cards.evidence_claim: Hollis Garden is a 1.2-acre botanical display garden at 614 East Orange Street with more than 10,000 flowers, shrubs and native trees.
cards.access_notes: 614 East Orange Street. Closed Mondays; posted seasonal hours and garden rules apply.

cards.title: Pause at the Lake Mirror Playground
cards.subtitle: East Orange Street — play and picnic space
cards.notes: Use East Orange Street for the park entrance, then choose the labyrinth, picnic area or multipurpose field without relying on the splash pad being open.
cards.short_summary: An all-ages Lake Mirror park with several distinct outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Barnett Family Park at 730 East Orange Street includes a splash pad, playgrounds, a labyrinth, covered picnic area, restrooms and multipurpose field.
cards.source_title: Barnett Family Park | City of Lakeland
cards.access_notes: 730 East Orange Street. Playground opens at 8 a.m.; splash pad is closed Wednesdays for maintenance.

cards.title: Find Downtown’s Civic Square
cards.subtitle: East Main Street — central public park
cards.notes: Approach from East Main Street and use Munn Park as the named destination for a downtown walk; check city notices when an event is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A city-managed outdoor venue anchoring its namesake historic district.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lakeland lists Munn Park at 201 East Main Street among its downtown outdoor venues.
cards.access_notes: 201 East Main Street. Public access can be affected by permitted events; consult city notices before visiting.

cards.title: Stop at the Original Café
cards.subtitle: East Main Street — downtown coffeehouse
cards.notes: Follow East Main Street to the flagship café facing Munn Park; review the current menu before deciding whether to order food or coffee.
cards.short_summary: Black & Brew’s original location occupies a documented downtown address.
cards.evidence_claim: Black & Brew identifies 205 East Main Street as its flagship store, opened in February 2006 in downtown Lakeland.
cards.source_title: Our Story - Black & Brew Coffee House and Bistro
cards.access_notes: 205 East Main Street. A purchase is required to consume menu items; consult the business for current hours.

cards.title: Take a South Florida Avenue Coffee Break
cards.subtitle: South Florida Avenue — Dixieland café
cards.notes: Walk west to South Florida Avenue and look behind the Dixieland plaza for the posted parking area; the café lists daily daytime hours.
cards.short_summary: A café stop on the South Florida Avenue commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Concord Coffee lists its Lakeland shop at 1037 South Florida Avenue, Suite 135, open daily from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: 1037 South Florida Avenue, Suite 135; daily 7 a.m.–5 p.m. Parking is listed behind the Dixieland plaza.

cards.title: Hear Music in a Bungalow Café
cards.subtitle: Hillcrest Street — coffee, art and music
cards.notes: Turn onto Hillcrest Street for the bungalow café; check its event listing before attending the donation-based Thursday evening music program.
cards.short_summary: A century-old bungalow café with a documented weekly music series.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillcrest Coffee operates at 119 Hillcrest Street and hosts original music on Thursdays from 6:30 to 9 p.m., with donation-based shows.
cards.source_title: Lakeland Coffee Made with Love | Hillcrest Coffee
cards.access_notes: 119 Hillcrest Street. Café hours vary by day; Thursday music is listed for 6:30–9 p.m. and is donation-based.

cards.title: Plan a Bakery Pickup
cards.subtitle: South Florida Avenue — limited-day bakehouse
cards.notes: Use South Florida Avenue and confirm the correct service day before leaving campus; preorder for a chosen pickup time or try a day-of walk-up.
cards.short_summary: A brick-and-mortar bakehouse with a limited weekly pickup schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Born & Bread Bakehouse is located at 1113 South Florida Avenue and serves customers Wednesdays and Saturdays, with preorders and day-of walk-ups.
cards.access_notes: 1113 South Florida Avenue; Wednesday 7 a.m.–2 p.m. and Saturday 8 a.m.–1 p.m. Confirm current service before traveling.
